just_in.title: Bollywood Studios Ride a Consolidation Wave as Big Money Reshapes Hindi Cinema

just_in.title: India Moves OCI Applications Fully Online Under New Citizenship Rules
just_in.excerpt: The Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2026, mandate electronic filing for all OCI services, introduce digital e-OCI cards, and bar minors from holding dual passports.
just_in.image_caption: India's new Citizenship Amendment Rules require all OCI registration and renunciation requests to be filed electronically through ociservices.gov.in.
just_in.nri_angle: The rules directly affect an estimated 4 million OCI cardholders worldwide, mandating digital-only applications, introducing e-OCI cards, and imposing new compliance obligations including a USD 25 fine for late passport updates.

just_in.title: Jadumani Singh Wins Silver in Men's 55kg Boxing at CWG 2026
just_in.excerpt: The 22-year-old Manipur boxer won four unanimous 5-0 bouts before falling to Australia's Jye Dixon in the final, capping India's dominant boxing campaign in Glasgow with 10 medals.
just_in.nri_angle: Jadumani's emotional Kargil dedication resonated with Indian fans in Glasgow and across the UK, while his silver adds to Manipur's boxing legacy following Mary Kom and Lovlina Borgohain.

just_in.title: Trump's Pharma Tariff Countdown Begins, Indian Generic Drugmakers Face Uncertain Future
just_in.excerpt: With a two-year grace period now ticking and 100% tariffs on generic drugs set for 2028, India's $8.7 billion pharmaceutical export pipeline to the US faces its biggest test yet.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian pharmaceutical companies that employ thousands of diaspora professionals face major revenue risk, while generic drug tariffs could raise medication costs for Indian-Americans who rely on affordable generics.

just_in.excerpt: A 358-page proposed rule would codify the 2022 EB-5 Reform Act, add a new high-employment-area investment category, and impose a graduated sanctions regime on regional centers — all as a September 30 grandfathering deadline looms.

just_in.title: Flipkart Enters Food Delivery With Low Commissions, Targeting Zomato-Swiggy Duopoly

just_in.nri_angle: Flipkart's low-commission entry could reshape food delivery pricing across India, affecting how diaspora families order food back home and signaling cheaper delivery for everyone.

just_in.title: Glyphosate Exposure During Mid-Pregnancy Linked to Preterm Birth Risk
just_in.excerpt: An NYU Langone study of 1,450 women found that higher levels of the common weedkiller Roundup's active ingredient during midpregnancy raised the odds of spontaneous early labor.

nri-world.nri_angle: Kwatra's Newsweek article represents India's diplomatic messaging to Western audiences, including the influential Indian-American diaspora, framing the treaty dispute as a security issue rather than a water rights question.

nri-world.nri_angle: China's experience of training top STEM talent that migrates abroad for career opportunities mirrors a familiar pattern for India, which has long grappled with its own brain drain of mathematicians and scientists to Western institutions.

nri-world.image_caption: Keigo Higashino, one of Japan's most acclaimed mystery novelists, has died at the age of 68.

food.nri_angle: For diaspora consumers who prize authentic Indian spices, the dispute raises questions about the true origin of cumin and fennel marketed under the Unjha label in international markets.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Garam Masala to Za'atar: The Ancient Spice Blends Modern Science Is Finally Validating
food.excerpt: Centuries-old spice blends from India, Morocco, Ethiopia, and Japan are drawing clinical attention as researchers document their anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and gut-health benefits in a booming $4.75 billion global market.
food.nri_angle: Indian diaspora's traditional spice knowledge is being validated by modern science while driving commercial demand in global markets
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Moringa Goes Mainstream: How India's Humble Drumstick Tree Conquered the Global Superfood Market
food.excerpt: The global moringa products market is projected to reach $15–25 billion by the mid-2030s, driven by demand for plant-based supplements and functional foods — with India supplying over 60% of the world's production.
food.nri_angle: Indian diaspora consumers find a familiar kitchen staple rebranded as a premium Western superfood, while diaspora entrepreneurs bridge Indian supply chains with branded consumer markets abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Makhana Kheer: A Creamy, Nutritious Dessert for Sawan Fasting Season
food.excerpt: This simple fox nut kheer combines roasted makhana, full-fat milk, and saffron into a satisfying vrat-friendly treat rich in protein and fiber.
food.nri_angle: Makhana is increasingly available at Indian grocery stores worldwide, making this a practical fasting recipe for diaspora families observing Sawan abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Karnataka Restaurants Escalate Revolt Against Swiggy and Zomato With August 15 Ultimatum
food.excerpt: Hotel and restaurant associations across Karnataka, from Bengaluru to tier-2 cities like Belagavi, are threatening a mass delisting from food delivery platforms over unauthorized deductions and crushing commissions.
food.nri_angle: The outcome could reshape operations for small family-run restaurants across Karnataka that serve as cultural touchstones for NRIs visiting their hometowns.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Randy's Donuts Opens Across From Beloved Stan's, Sparking Santa Clara's Doughnut Showdown
food.excerpt: The iconic Los Angeles chain planted its first Bay Area location directly opposite a 65-year-old family institution, turning a quiet stretch of Homestead Road into Silicon Valley's sweetest battleground.
food.nri_angle: The franchise owner Ausaf Masud and the large Indian-American community in Santa Clara highlight how immigrant entrepreneurship shapes Silicon Valley's food scene.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Karnataka Ships First Air Cargo of Totapuri and Neelam Mangoes to Maldives
food.excerpt: APEDA-backed initiative sources late-season mango varieties from Kolar's farmer-producer company, delivering 50% higher returns to growers and extending India's export window.
food.nri_angle: Late-season Totapuri and Neelam mangoes reaching new markets like the Maldives could expand availability of these popular South Indian varieties for overseas Indian communities.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Chipotle Raises Sales Outlook, Says Value Perception Is Improving
food.excerpt: CEO Scott Boatwright pointed to the best affordability scores in two years as Q2 revenue topped Wall Street estimates, though a cyclospora outbreak dented July traffic.
food.nri_angle: Chipotle's customizable bowls and value-priced protein options remain popular among South Asian diners seeking affordable, build-your-own meals.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How to Make Authentic Agra-Style Kesar Petha at Home in Three Steps
food.excerpt: This saffron-scented ash gourd sweet, a signature delicacy of Agra, can be recreated in your own kitchen with just a handful of ingredients and a little patience.
food.nri_angle: For Indians abroad craving authentic Agra petha, this straightforward home recipe brings a taste of the city's most famous sweet to diaspora kitchens worldwide.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: WestJet Flight Attendants Issue Strike Notice, Threatening Peak Summer Travel
travel.excerpt: Canada's second-largest airline faces a potential walkout starting August 2 after cabin crew issued a 72-hour strike notice over a dispute about unpaid work, with 75,000 passengers at risk.
travel.nri_angle: With over 1.8 million people of Indian origin in Canada, the potential WestJet disruption during peak summer travel could affect diaspora travelers and their connecting itineraries.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Indian Passport Now Offers Visa-Free or Visa-on-Arrival Access to 74 Countries
travel.excerpt: India's Ministry of External Affairs lists 27 visa-free and 47 visa-on-arrival destinations for Indian citizens in 2026, with Malaysia, Thailand, and Kazakhstan among the notable entries.
travel.nri_angle: Indians abroad with U.S., UK, or Schengen visas gain additional visa-free access to countries like Argentina, South Korea, and Mexico, creating new leisure and business travel options.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo Signs MoU With Ministry of Tourism to Promote Incredible India
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline partners with the government's flagship tourism initiative as the ministry accelerates corporate tie-ups with airlines, tech companies, and content platforms to modernise the Incredible India brand.
travel.image_caption: IndiGo, India's largest airline, has signed an MoU with the Ministry of Tourism to promote the Incredible India campaign across its network of over 400 aircraft.
travel.nri_angle: IndiGo's expanding international network and codeshare partnerships create new touchpoints for NRIs and PIOs to discover India's tourism offerings on routes they already fly.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bhogapuram Airport, Andhra Pradesh's First Greenfield Hub
travel.excerpt: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport near Visakhapatnam opens with a 6-million passenger capacity and plans to transform North Coastal Andhra's economic landscape.
travel.nri_angle: The new international airport offers direct connectivity options for the Telugu diaspora, particularly those with roots in Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram, and Srikakulam districts.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Five Structural Barriers That Keep Foreign Tourists Away From India
travel.excerpt: Despite world-class cultural heritage, India captures just 1.4% of global tourist arrivals — held back by visa friction, steep taxes, scam risks, regulatory red tape, and overtourism at flagship destinations.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who host visiting friends and family in India regularly encounter these barriers firsthand, from visa headaches to tourist scams and overtourism at popular destinations.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo to Discontinue All Widebody Operations, End Norse Atlantic Lease
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline will switch Mumbai-Amsterdam to A321XLR and suspend London Heathrow service until its own Airbus A350s arrive, citing geopolitical disruptions.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers in the US and UK face disruptions as IndiGo's ambitious long-haul expansion hits turbulence, with London Heathrow service suspended indefinitely and route changes affecting diaspora travel plans.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Danube Hits Record Lows, Stranding Cruise Ships and Threatening Energy Across Central Europe
travel.excerpt: Europe's second-longest river has dropped to unprecedented levels in Hungary, Serbia, and Romania, forcing cruise cancellations, grounding a Viking ship, and pushing Hungary toward a nuclear plant shutdown.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers planning European river cruises this summer face widespread itinerary disruptions and cancellations on the Danube and Rhine.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Cordelia Cruises Eyes Mangaluru as Next Port of Call in Fleet Expansion Push
travel.excerpt: Waterways Leisure Tourism, India's only listed domestic cruise operator, is evaluating New Mangalore Port for future cruise services as it prepares to nearly triple fleet capacity by 2028.
travel.image_caption: New Mangalore Port, which Cordelia Cruises is eyeing as its next port of call for Indian coastal routes.
travel.nri_angle: Cordelia's Indian-centric cruise experience and potential Mangaluru embarkation point offer NRI travellers, especially those with ties to coastal Karnataka, a new way to explore India by sea.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: India's Inbound Tourism Problem: Overseas Marketing Budget Slashed to ₹3.5 Crore
travel.excerpt: India's overseas tourism promotion allocation has collapsed from ₹542 crore in 2019 to ₹3.5 crore in FY27, leaving the country's inbound recovery lagging behind competitors while outbound travel booms.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who promote India as a travel destination to friends and colleagues find the country lacks the institutional marketing that competing destinations deploy.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: SkyDrive and Suzuki Deepen India eVTOL Push with Kineco Manufacturing Pact
travel.excerpt: Japan's SkyDrive has partnered with Indian composite manufacturer Kineco to build parts for its SD-05 air taxi, adding to Suzuki's growing role in bringing eVTOL technology to Indian cities.
travel.nri_angle: The SkyDrive-Suzuki-India partnership could create new aerospace manufacturing jobs in India and bring air taxi services to congested Indian cities.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Indians in China Flag Growing Visa Hurdles and Social Media Restrictions
carousel.excerpt: With visa rejection rates approaching 40% and China's Great Firewall blocking everyday apps, the roughly 56,000 Indians living in the country face mounting daily challenges.
carousel.image_caption: India's ambassador to China said visa issues remain a top concern as new COVA pre-approval requirements push rejection rates for Indian applicants close to 40 percent.
carousel.nri_angle: Indians living in China face a dual squeeze — blocked from global social media by the Great Firewall and confronting rising visa rejection rates — creating daily challenges despite warming diplomatic ties.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Assam Flood Death Toll Hits 85 as Waters Recede Across Upper Assam
carousel.excerpt: Three more deaths push toll higher even as affected population drops sharply to 1.35 lakh from a peak of 10 lakh, with floodwaters receding across Sivasagar and Charaideo.
carousel.nri_angle: Indians abroad with family in Assam's Brahmaputra Valley face lingering economic fallout from massive agricultural and infrastructure damage even as floodwaters recede.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Bollywood Studios Ride a Consolidation Wave as Big Money Reshapes Hindi Cinema
carousel.excerpt: From Dharma Productions to Excel Entertainment, a string of high-profile stake sales and mergers signals a new era for Bollywood as outside capital pours into the industry.
carousel.nri_angle: Studios are increasingly targeting international markets and streaming platforms available globally, giving diaspora audiences a wider pipeline of Indian-origin content from festivals to franchise films.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Jadumani Singh Wins Silver in Men's 55kg Boxing at CWG 2026
carousel.excerpt: The 22-year-old Manipur boxer won four unanimous 5-0 bouts before falling to Australia's Jye Dixon in the final, capping India's dominant boxing campaign in Glasgow with 10 medals.
carousel.nri_angle: Jadumani's emotional Kargil dedication resonated with Indian fans in Glasgow and across the UK, while his silver adds to Manipur's boxing legacy following Mary Kom and Lovlina Borgohain.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: GalaxEye Launches World's First OptoSAR Satellite Aboard SpaceX Falcon 9
carousel.excerpt: Bengaluru startup's Mission Drishti combines radar and optical sensors on a single platform, marking India's largest privately built satellite.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-origin aerospace professionals and investors see Drishti as a sign that Indian startups are becoming system-level competitors in dual-use space technology.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Trump's Pharma Tariff Countdown Begins, Indian Generic Drugmakers Face Uncertain Future
carousel.excerpt: With a two-year grace period now ticking and 100% tariffs on generic drugs set for 2028, India's $8.7 billion pharmaceutical export pipeline to the US faces its biggest test yet.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian pharmaceutical companies that employ thousands of diaspora professionals face major revenue risk, while generic drug tariffs could raise medication costs for Indian-Americans who rely on affordable generics.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
